text: The oracle may be inferred to give consent from the circumstance of her returning with the words on her honey lips that they can come in if they want to it. Thus privileged, they come in and find Mr. Smallweed with his feet in the drawer of his chair as if it were a paper foot-bath and Mrs. Smallweed obscured with the cushion like a bird that is not to sing. “My dear friend,” says Grandfather Smallweed with those two lean affectionate arms of his stretched forth. Who is our friend, my dear friend?” “Why this,” returns George, not able to be very conciliatory at first, “is Matthew Bagnet, who has obliged me in that matter of ours, you know.” “Oh! Mr. Bagnet?
